# Paul Irving

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixteen years old
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c11 P45](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0045)</sub>
- **Origin:** Boston, Massachusetts, United States  <sub>[v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and writer  <sub>[v2 c11 P45](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0045)</sub>

## Appearance

Paul has refined features, dark blue eyes the same color as his father's, and brown curls. He is physically well-built, manly, and has grown to six feet tall.

_Sources: [v2 c19 P25](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0025), [v2 c19 P26](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0026), [v2 c28 P28](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0028)_

## Personality

Paul is a sensitive, imaginative, and polite boy with a poetic turn of mind. He possesses a vivid imagination and loves creating whimsical stories about nature and fictional rock people. Highly fair-minded and articulate, he expresses himself with gentlemanly courtesy and deep warmth toward those who understand his perspective.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 c19 P28](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0028), [v2 c19 P33](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0033)_

## Traits

- Imaginative  <sub>[v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c19 P28](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0028)</sub>
- Fair-minded  <sub>[v2 c23 P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036)</sub>

## Abilities

- Storytelling and creative writing  <sub>[v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)</sub>
- Athletic gaming skills

## Goals

- To share his imaginative thoughts with those who understand him  <sub>[v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c19 P27](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0027)</sub>

## History

After moving to Avonlea to reside with his grandmother, Paul became a pupil of Anne Shirley at the local schoolhouse. He quickly formed a strong emotional and creative connection with Anne, recognizing her as a kindred spirit who understood his imaginative ideas. During his school years, he invented vivid stories about rock people, fairies, and sunset adventures, confiding them to Anne. He also developed a friendship with Miss Lavendar Lewis, noting her resemblance to his late mother's affectionate demeanor. When his father, Stephen Irving, returned to Avonlea, Paul welcomed him joyfully and helped rekindle the romance between Stephen and Miss Lavendar. As he grew older, Paul matured into a tall youth of six feet, continuing to write poetry and maintaining his warm affection for his former teacher.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 c19 P28](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0028), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083), [v2 c23 P34](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0034), [v2 c28 P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 c28 P26](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0026)_

## Quotes

> There are a great many people who do not understand things so there is no use in telling them.  <sub>[v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041)</sub>

> My eyes are the same color as father’s... but father’s hair is gray.  <sub>[v2 c19 P26](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0026)</sub>

> I think an angel walks over the world after the sun sets . . . a great, tall, white angel, with silvery folded wings . . . and sings the flowers and birds to sleep.  <sub>[v2 c19 P28](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0028)</sub>

> I think the violets are little snips of the sky that fell down when the angels cut out holes for the stars to shine through.  <sub>[v2 c19 P32](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0032)</sub>

> Because you looked at me just as my little mother used to do when she wanted to kiss me.  <sub>[v2 c23 P34](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0034)</sub>
